package.name: kai_sonar_bridge
package.description: Brings the gz_sonar sonars into ROS 2: converts gz.maritime.sonar.SonarImage to marine_acoustic_msgs/ProjectedSonarImage, and optionally draws each sonar for viewing (an imaging sonar's fan, a sidescan's waterfall) as sensor_msgs/Image. ros_gz_bridge cannot, as it converts only the DVL message from marine_acoustic_msgs.
